OMB_SIGNIN_EMAILS.description: Your email address (comma-separate several, or @yourcompany.com for a whole domain). They sign in at /pair with an emailed code and get full access.

OMB_SIGNIN_MEMBER_EMAILS.description: Optional. Emails that may sign in for chat and approvals only, without settings or keys.

OMB_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public address used in pairing links. Change it to https://your-domain after adding a custom domain.

OMB_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_URL.description: Address printed in webhook URLs (/hooks/...). Keep it equal to OMB_PUBLIC_URL.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds a running deployment gets to finish bot turns before a redeploy replaces it.

PORT.description: Port of the web edge Railway routes to. Do not change.
